concepts.def: Oscillation of a system at its natural frequency with no external driving force.
Oscillation produced by a periodic external driving force.
Large-amplitude oscillation when the driving frequency equals the natural frequency.
Reduction of amplitude of oscillations due to dissipation of energy as heat.
The minimum damping that returns the system to equilibrium without oscillation in the shortest time.
The frequency at which a system oscillates when displaced and released without external driving.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Waves.
